_README: Provider config for fanout_run.py. Every provider speaks the OpenAI-compatible
/chat/completions shape, including local Ollama, so one code path covers all of them.
rpm / rpd / tpd are the caps the RUNNER will respect. They are not promises from the
provider. Set them to what YOUR OWN account page shows, not to what a docs page or a
blog says. Groq's rate-limits page lists gpt-oss-120b at 30 RPM / 1000 RPD / 200K TPD
but also says those are base limits for the Developer plan and does not label a
free-tier table, so the numbers below are a conservative guess and MUST be replaced
from console.groq.com before a long run. Limits there apply per organisation.
logprobs: 'yes' = send logprobs/top_logprobs. 'no' = do not send them at all.
'probe' = try once; if the provider rejects the parameter, fall back and record
score_mode=emitted_only for every row from that model. The fallback is recorded per
row, never assumed away: an expected-rating analysis can only pool models that
Set enabled=false to leave a provider out without deleting its config.
API keys are read from the named environment variable and never written to any output.

ollama.note: Local. The published pilot ran here. Free and unlimited, but 8 GB of VRAM caps it at 7B-8B.

groq.note: rpd and tpm confirmed from this account's response headers on 27 Nov 2026. tpd RETIRED the same day: it was 200000 from Groq's docs table, appears in no response header, and as a hard wall it stopped gpt-oss-20b at 266 of 400 rows while the server still reported 783 of 1000 requests remaining. The headers report x-ratelimit-limit-tokens=8000 resetting in under a second, which is a per-MINUTE cap and is kept as tpm. rpm comes from the docs table and is still unverified. Key confirmed PERSISTENT at Windows User scope.

openrouter.note: 50 requests a day on :free until a $10 credit purchase raises it. Pin exact :free ids at run time; availability changes weekly.

google.note: Free-tier content is used to improve Google's products. Public Amazon review text only. Never a hypothesis file.

openai.note: THIS ONE COSTS MONEY. A key is already set in this machine's environment. Leave enabled=false until you decide to spend it, and set a tpd you are willing to pay for.

cerebras.note: Caps from this account's headers 27 Nov 2026. gpt-oss-120b is the tighter model: 5/min, 150/hour, 2400/day. EXPLORATORY provider for E1 only; the locked models run on Groq per deviation 02.
